tvShow.name: Kaulitz & Kaulitz
tvShow.overview: Twin brothers and superstars Tom and Bill Kaulitz offer a glimpse into their private lives in LA and Germany in this funny and intimate reality series.

episodes.name: The Party Has Arrived!
episodes.overview: After five months on tour, the Kaulitz twins are missing home. Finally back in Los Angeles, they celebrate their birthday in style.

episodes.name: Strange Childhood
episodes.overview: Questions about the past and future lurk behind every corner as Tom and Bill confront a psychic, a storage unit and dinner with old friends.

episodes.name: Back to the Future
episodes.overview: Welcome to the recording studio! We go behind the scenes as Tom and Bill chat away on their podcast, and Bill takes a fun trip to Austin.

episodes.name: Flirty Wiesn
episodes.overview: The twins get their own traditional — or in Bill's case, hot pink — Lederhosen for the Oktoberfest celebrations in Munich, where the night stirs drama.

episodes.name: Finally Free!
episodes.overview: We get a glimpse of the role Bill's sexuality has played in his and Tom's grapple with fame as they deal with the aftermath of the trip to Munich.

episodes.name: Quark Balls and Heidi-ween
episodes.overview: It's time for Heidi Klum's legendary Halloween Party! Bill plans his costume and expects a special guest, while Tom prepares his big reveal.

episodes.name: Road Trip with Obstacles
episodes.overview: Bonding time! Not everything goes to plan as Bill and Tom go on a campervan road trip to spend some special time together.

episodes.name: To Be Continued?
episodes.overview: Tom and Bill get ready for and eagerly await the results of the Voice Germany's finale. The twins review their last year — and look ahead.

episodes.name: Manic Mouse
episodes.overview: Tom has trouble reining in his wayward brother, who is dealing with his heartbreak by going shopping and planning a big home renovation.

episodes.name: Soggy News
episodes.overview: Faced with questions about their commitment to the band, Tom and Bill promise to write new songs — until a new crisis derails their good intentions.

episodes.name: Little Jinx & Big Willy
episodes.overview: After organizing a casting session to hire a new personal assistant, Bill heads out for a Vogue photo shoot while Tom looks around for a new studio.

episodes.name: (No) Second Chance
episodes.overview: A live podcast recording and a lavish casino-themed birthday party hold several surprises for Tom and Bill — but not all of them are pleasant.

episodes.name: Fricassee and Turbulences
episodes.overview: While visiting their new office in Berlin and planning the upcoming Tokio Hotel tour, Tom and Bill end up arguing over who the biggest diva is.

episodes.name: What Happens in Jackson Hole...
episodes.overview: After taking a lesson in etiquette, Tom and Bill organize an elaborate bachelor party in Wyoming for band member Georg.

episodes.name: Foot the Bill
episodes.overview: Tom and Bill explore their deep connection and rediscover they can always rely on each other — especially when diving with sharks.

episodes.name: When It Rains, It Pours
episodes.overview: The whirlwind year ends on a sour note as headaches, technical issues and a heartbreaking no-show complicate the Tokio Hotel tour.
